text:
maya: RFR: PR #16788 — need help with merge timing. mac-e2e keeps flaking in CI and the midnight deploy freeze starts in 6 hours. Is there a rebase window or manual merge we can use?

alex: tagging @jen and @sre-oncall. can you advise on rebase slot availability?

ci-bot: mac-e2e (job 9876) flaked on timeout in matrix/arm64. Rerun allowed: yes. Current queue length: 14.

jen: hey — we have a short DB migration blackout at 23:30, so avoid merges 23:00-00:30. earlier slot today is tight. Can you reduce matrix to linux-only to land earlier?

maya: reducing matrix is fine for this change (no platform-specific). i'll push a commit to skip mac for ci. plan: push quick rebase -> trigger linux + mac rerun after.

sam: FYI policy: during freeze we don't accept hotfix merges without approvals from infra. if you land before 23:00 it's ok.

maya: ok pushing now. command i'll run:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout pr/16788
git rebase origin/main
git push --force-with-lease
```

alex: ping @ryan for final review/approve? rapid +1 will help.

ryan: taking a look now. small nit but non-blocking. approving if CI passes :+1:

ci-bot: Triggered pipeline 21234 (linux only) — queued.

maya: linux passed, mac queued (we left mac in the matrix but will let it backfill). anyone object to landing once linux green? would avoid DB blackout.

jen: fine to land on linux green. add a brief rollback note in the PR description in case mac fails post-merge.

sre-oncall: i'll watch deploy and roll back if mac causes regressions. set a monitor alert for error rate spike on inference-service.

maya: merged at 1747013289. thanks all. follow-up: i'll open a short post-merge check thread if mac post-merge jobs fail.

alex: thanks @maya and team :tada:

ci-bot: mac post-merge pipeline 21235 started (backfill). status: running.
